_comment: Hand-edited. TV/stream network per event. Not overwritten by fetch scripts. Lookup order: events[<event id>] -> defaults[<competition>] -> null (shown as 'TBD').
_note_nfl: NFL games carry a real TV network from ESPN; only add NFL entries here to correct one.
_note_bayern: Bundesliga/Supercup 2026-27 US rights are Versant's, split per-match between USA Network and Fandango (free stream) - the ESPN API carries the right value per game (blank until ESPN assigns it), so no per-competition default. UCL is Paramount+. Add a per-event entry to correct one.
